# Fists (skill)

Description: Determines damage with Bare Fists and, Fist, weapons.

# Introduction

Fists is a skill related to Fists weapon class, including Bare fists.

## Effects

Higher skill level in fists reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

## Leveling up

The player gains 1.5xp per one-handed and 1xp per two-handed attack when hitting a creature.

## Notes

• Skill ID is Unarmed (to use with raiseskill or resetskill commands).
• Fists was previously named Unarmed prior to the Frost Caves update.
